decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display sits at the core of the firm's display offer and has its own website page, so dropping it would undo a visible commitment, and weak early results can still be put down to market ramp-up.
This pegboard shelf display is close to the established offer, costs little to keep on the market, and is publicly presented, so there is little reason to write it off after only one year.
The standard quarter-pallet display is central to the firm's one-stop display range, and management is committed to it in public.
The eighth-pallet display rounds out the standard format range and is visibly presented, so management will persist with it while results can still be explained by temporary causes.

The wooden display pallet moves beyond cardboard and needed more investment and justification, which makes management inclined to persist despite uncertain early results, though it is less central to the paper-based core.
The media display serves a niche segment that may shrink, but little time has passed and it remains on the website, so management will attribute any weakness to temporary factors.
